ZombieArcade.description: Pushes an arcade cabinet that jams the lawn with 8-bit trouble.

ZombieBarrel.description: Rolls a barrel that can dump pirate imps onto the lawn.

ZombieBeachFisherman.description: Hooks plants from deep water and reels them toward the tide.

ZombieBeachOctopus.description: Hurls octopi that bind plants and take them out of the fight.

ZombieBeachSnorkel.description: Dives underwater, then pops up to eat. Hard to hit while submerged.

ZombieBossBeach.description: Dr. Zomboss in the Sharktronic Sub. Vacuums plants and summons sharks.

ZombieBossDragon.description: Dr. Zomboss in the Dark Dragon. Fireballs, imps, and lane-clearing flame.

ZombieBossEgypt.description: Dr. Zomboss in the Sphinx-inator. Three-phase Egypt boss fight.

ZombieBossMammoth.description: Dr. Zomboss in the Tuskmaster. Ice winds, ice blocks, and a glacier shield.

ZombieCrystalSkull.description: Charges a crystal skull laser that can wipe a whole column.

ZombieDarkArmor3.description: A knighted Dark Ages zombie wearing crown and shoulder armor.

ZombieDarkImpDragon.description: A flying imp dragon that shrugs off fire damage.

ZombieDarkKing.description: Stays put and knights nearby zombies with extra armor.

ZombieExplorer.description: Carries a torch that can ignite plants if it gets too close.

ZombieFrozen.description: An ice-age basic zombie used for frozen-lawn encounters.

ZombieIceAgeDodo.description: Rides a dodo and hops over plants and obstacles.

ZombieIceAgeHunter.description: Lobs snowballs that freeze plants from several tiles away.

ZombieIceAgeTroglobite.description: Pushes ice blocks that crush anything in front of them.

ZombieLostCityJane.description: Bounces lobbed projectiles back at your plants.

ZombieModernAllStar.description: Charges down a lane at football speed, smashing plants in his path.

ZombieNewspaper.description: Calm behind his paper, then enraged and lightning-fast when it rips.

ZombiePiano.description: A piano zombie that crushes plants and plays a deadly tune.

ZombieProspector.description: Dynamite-packs himself and blasts to the left side of the lawn.

ZombieRa.description: Steals sun from the lawn and keeps it until you take him down.

ZombieTombRaiser.description: Raises tombstones on empty tiles, blocking planting space.

ZombieWizard.description: Zaps plants into helpless sheep until he is defeated.
